title: Case Studies — Client Results | Khalid Farhan
metaDesc: 24 case studies from Khalid Farhan's marketing agency: SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, websites and email, with the numbers before and after.

blocks.text: 24 pieces of work, each with the numbers before and after. We do not name clients here. We say what kind of business it was, where it was, what we changed, and what happened.
